post_title: Pay cash or get a mortgage? Same $206K, different plan.
caption:

• Cash flow: +$1,103 vs +$105 a month. Cash wins.
• Cash-on-cash: 6.4% vs 2.2%. Cash wins.
• Houses with $206K: 1 vs 3. Mortgage wins.

Two all. Cash flow now, or more doors working for you.
